caption: The drawing shows a wooden bird decoy mounted on a vertical, brown stick. The bird has a pointed beak, rounded head, and streamlined body with a short tail. Its coloring features a brownish-black back with green mottled and yellow spotted patterns, while the underside and head are lighter, appearing grayish with brown shading. The mounting stick is depicted as straight and pointed at the lower end, with the bird fixed to its upper end via a short, horizontal brass or gold-colored sleeve. Beneath the colored bird decoy, two schematic line drawings outline the form and construction: the left one is a front view showing the stick and the bird’s symmetrical shape, and the right one is a side-by-side outline indicating how two bird profiles could be cut from a single piece of material. The background is a plain, off-white color without any additional markings except for a small signature or inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Snipe Decoy
